t_advice_summary_textbox.text: During the 1x game, try to remember which type / colour gnomes are worth the most money, because this can maximise earnings during the 5x rounds

vb_textbox.text: Try to remember which colour and which size gnome has the most points. The rule on which gnome earns the most seems to switch sometimes, so don't be afraid to re-learn the colours if you seem to be seeing gnomes suddenly earning less points than before. I'm unsure whether it makes a difference which side the gnome appears on.
